usedFor: Hive holds project actions and Slack holds team chat, so “Updated Action” can run “Send Message” to a channel.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Action” in Hive, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Changed work in Hive reaches the channel where the team already talks, with no status chase.

watchOut: “Updated Action” in Hive is polling, and the Slack post waits for your approval before it goes out.
